rates.label: All classes
rates.value: About 2% of insured value per year

assumptions: The demo date is 2026-11-16 and the forward horizon is 12 months.
Road distance uses saved driving distances; straight-line x 1.3 only when a route is missing; a truck move costs $150 plus $4.50/km.
The internal rental rate is 88% of the outside rate. Research suggests about 75%, so this is an assumption.

A purchase only counts if one extra unit nets a positive 12 months: outside rent avoided on the days it would cover, minus a year of depreciation plus maintenance and insurance. Break-even is purchase price over monthly net saving, not the cash purchase price.

The backtest history is synthetic. Assumption: about 1 in 5 outside rentals had a comparable idle group or sister unit, based on industry interviews and published fleet-utilization figures; this 20% rate is drawn independently of the decision that was made.

In the backtest, idle units sit at the group and rental yards and are trucked to the site at current truck rates. Buy is excluded because historical pipeline demand is unknown, costs use the current rate card, and ties keep the original decision.
Equipment, projects, companies and sites are fictional Northgate Group data.
